item.title: Ananda - mImAMsA sAmya tAratamya
item.description:
Joy/ Ananda mImAMsA - rAmAnuja’s sAmya vs madhva’s tAratamya; evidence choice, handling & attitude

Source: TW

विस्तारः (द्रष्टुं नोद्यम्)

00:00 - mangalam 01:15 - Question - muktas and brahman - Ananda level? 03:00 - Agreement - varying source of Joy. (Correction: mAdhvas, unlike SVs, say bhagavAn doesn’t derive joy from exterior sources like lakShmI.) service vs lordship. Unique attributes of Ishvara. Differences in saMsAra. 05:30 - Evidence - shabda-pramANa, secondarily logic. 06:40 - Peek into rAmAnujIya vs mAdhva handling of pramANa-s. 08:00 - Ananda-mImAMsA shruti in taittirIya upaniShat (Ananda-vallI / brahma-vallI) 11:10 - Natural meaning - Gramatically different sentences. Chanted that way. 17:30 - x1 has 10Rs, y too. x2 has 100 Rs, y too… अयोग-व्यवच्छेद. Confirmation by “यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते”. 20:40 - y refers to mukta-s. x to baddha-s. 23:40 - mAdhva-meaning - Different mukta-s - y ⊂ x1 has 10Rs, y ⊂ x2 has 100Rs, …? 26:30 - Need to mutiliate word order or insert? 28:00 - अन्ययोग-व्यवच्छेद. 28:22 - Trouble with attributes like yuvA, adhyApaka etc.. No mukta-reference. 30:15 - Ananda-mImAMsA shruti in bRihadAraNyaka upaniShat 33:00 - Mirrors taittirIya shruti. Good to read together. 33:30 - Natural meaning - x1 has 10Rs, y too. x2 has 100 Rs, y too… अयोग-व्यवच्छेद. 36:00 - y refers to mukta-s. x to baddha-s. 36:50 - mAdhva-meaning - Different mukta-s 38:00 - Need to insert/ assume unheard word? 39:00 - Missing mukta references. Trouble with attributes like rAddha, adhyApaka etc.. 41:35 - y ⊂ x1 has 10Rs, y ⊂ x2 has 100Rs, …? - अन्ययोग-व्यवच्छेद. 43:30 - parama Ananda of brahman = mukta. एष/ this twice. Utility as per rAmAnuja. 47:15 - madhva - 2 different brahman-s in succeeding sentences? 50:30 - Comparison to shankara’s 2 brahman-s in brahma-sUtra 2 sUtras. 52:40 - A different brahman just in this one sentence? bRhad-AraNyaka, taittirIya. 55:00 - taittirIya - “यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते” 56:00 - prajApati - purANic 4-faced brahmA per rAmAnujIya-s (esp. when para-brahma is referred to by another word.) 57:20 - madhva - rudra?! Genital-connection “शिश्न-देव”. Can’t be mukta - so sheSha!? garuDa?! 01:02:13 - Supporting evidence. None? 01:03:40 - Other shruti-s, brahma-sUtras - परमं साम्यम् उपैति। Resort to lakShaNa/ implied meanings? 01:04:50 - sAttvika viShNu-purANa? 01:09:35 - rAjasika brahmANDa-purANa shloka-s untraceable in common editions?
01:10:10 - Interpretation relative to stronger evidence? 01:10:45 - taittirIya - “yajus-saMhitA” with no hint of being vedic. 01:13:30 - Acknowledgement - Conversation with a mAdhva. 01:14:30 - Debate culture. Vehement relativism vs objectivity. Fanaticism vs auto-correction. 01:17:15 - mAdhva-s - Admiration, close connection. 01:18:00 - Conclusion - Respect for rAmAnuja and madhva. Good intentions, caught shankara. Probity different. Which approach do you prefer?

item.title: UpAdAna
item.description:
ಜಗದ್-ಉಪಾದಾನ jagad-upAdAna, sharIra-sharIri-bhAva - mAdhva shrIvaiShNava similarity (subtitles)

Subtitles: TW

विस्तारः (द्रष्टुं नोद्यम्)

This video features a scholarly discussion on the core differences between the Madhva (Dvaita) and Ramanuja (Vishishtadvaita) schools of Vedanta, focusing on the concept of Sharira-Shariri Bhava (the relationship between the body and the soul/controller).

  • The Madhva View (Speaker 1): Argues that God (Narayana) possesses a completely transcendental body made of pure knowledge and bliss (Jnana-Anandatmaka). Material nature (Prakriti) and flawed individual souls (Jivas) can never be considered God’s body. God pervades everything as the inner controller (Antaryami) but remains entirely distinct from material creation. He is strictly the efficient cause (Nimitta Karana), not the material cause (Upadana Karana).
  • The Ramanuja View (Speaker 2): Argues that according to the scriptural texts (Shrutis), there exists a literal Sharira-Shariri Bhava where the universe and the souls constitute the “body” of the Supreme Lord, who is the soul. They propose Visheshana Parinamavada (transformation of God’s attributes/body) rather than Svaroopa Parinamavada (transformation of His essential nature), suggesting the difference between the two schools on this point is largely a matter of terminology rather than core intent.

visheShaNa-pariNAma, brahman as upAdAna - mAdhva-rAmAnujIya-saMvAda (En subtitles)

item.title: देवादि
item.description:
mAdhva avatAra-confusion vs pAncharAtra (kn) - balarAma, chaitanya, svAmi-nArAyaNa, vyAsa

Source: TW

विस्तारः (द्रष्टुं नोद्यम्)

For English/ Hindi subtitles, please use ⚙️ icon in the (lower?) video bar.

00:00 - Intro 00:30 - mAhuli AchArya’s statement https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y8n-yf4V0Zc00:00 - Intro 03:50 - ಅವತಾರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಗಳು (Scriptural evidence for Incarnations) 04:50 - ಅವತಾರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಾಗ (Classification of Incarnations) 06:50 - ಬಲರಾಮನಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಮಾನುಜೀಯಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ (The Ramanujiya view on Lord Balarama) 09:00 - ವ್ಯಾಸರ ಆವೇಶಾವತಾರತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಮಾನುಜೀಯಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ (The Ramanujiya view on Vyasa as an Aveshavatara) 10:25 - ಚೈತನ್ಯರು, ಸ್ವಾಮಿನಾರಾಯಣರು - ಇವರ ಅನವತಾರತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ-ವೈಕಲ್ಯ (Chaitanya and Swaminarayan - Lack of scriptural evidence for their non-avatar status) 12:00 - ವ್ಯಾಸರ ಆವೇಶಾವತಾರತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಂಚರಾತ್ರಾಗಮ (Pancharatra Agama on Vyasa as an Aveshavatara) Correction - cited in sAttvata saMhitA comentary and older texts, but supposedly from विष्वक्सेनसंहिता, तत्त्व., पृ. 130-132 17:00 - ಕಲ್ಪಭೇದೇನ ಪರಿಹಾರೇ ಕೇಷಾಂಚನಾಯಾಸಃ (Efforts by some to resolve contradictions using Kalpabheda) 18:15 - ಅವತಾರಾನ್ತರರ ಆರಾಧ್ಯತ್ವ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಭೇದೇನ (Worshipability of other incarnations based on the qualification of the seeker) 20:50 - ಉಪಸಂಹಾರ (Conclusion)
